ada:analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmentMetho: Sc: good agreement with Davis (1977) INAA values within measurement scatter; overall accuracy verified by comparison with literature INAA and SIMS data; Marjalahti used as in-session control (Mn deviation from reference value noted as 4.2% above Ryder 1984)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sample Form / Analytical Substrate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: In situ — polished grain mount (olivine grain fragments)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sample Preparation Method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Olivine grain fragments repeatedly washed in dilute HCl and triply distilled H₂O, hand-picked, polished grain mounts

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Analysis Sequence
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: BCR-2g, BHVO-2g, BIR-1g measured as calibration standards; Marjalahti as in-session control

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Time steps with enhanced P, Ca, Co, Ni, Zn excluded (inclusions and heterogeneities); Grubb's test applied to EPMA data for outlier detection

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: No post-acquisition normalization; BCR-2g, BHVO-2g, BIR-1g used for calibration; Marjalahti as in-session control

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Primary Calibration Standard Name
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: USGS standard glasses BCR-2g, BHVO-2g, and BIR-1g; preferred values from GeoReM website

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Secondary Reference Materials
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: BCR-2G, BHVO-2G, BIR-1G processed as unknowns alongside samples (same standards as calibration — in-session validation)
